metadata.model: Composite TfL recurring timetable and public timetable-PDF interpolation / not realtime
metadata.note: Complete audited Friday service day for all advertised Tube, DLR and Tramlink lines, all six named London Overground lines and the Elizabeth line branch family. TfL services whose published timetable crosses midnight remain attached to their originating service day.

sources.model: Composite TfL recurring timetable and public timetable-PDF interpolation / not realtime
sources.note: Every advertised tube, dlr, tram line compiled from each directional branch origin in the catalogue for the shared morning window. Short turns remain distinct through their source interval and path identities. Elizabeth line and London Overground are compiled separately from public timetable PDFs.

sources.model: Composite TfL recurring timetable and public timetable-PDF interpolation / not realtime
sources.note: Every advertised London Overground and Elizabeth line branch was audited against the current TfL public timetable PDFs. Active weekday branch patterns are compiled; topology-only or non-through branches are recorded explicitly.

geometry.model: Deduplicated TfL branch paths from component fixtures

labelHierarchy.model: Stable station-name rank by mode interchange, distinct routes, scheduled calls and graph degree, enriched by advertised topology
